description: Cross-language contract for F-048/F-056: bank/UPI/card SMS -> expected classification and parse. The desktop (Halo/Features/Expenditure, HaloTests ExpenseFixtures) and the phone (android/halocloud ExpenseFixtureTest) both read the SAME rules from india-bank-sms.v1.json, and both must produce exactly the 'expect' blocks below - there is no per-platform override. Expectations follow the spec (F-048, F-044 7.4), not whichever implementation was written first; a message that was once recorded as a known quirk is now fixed and its note says what changed. All messages are synthetic (no real account data).

messages.body: A/C *XX3833 debited by Rs 1250.00 via UPI. Avl Bal:8420.10 -IndusInd
messages.note: Category is 'Transfers' only because the body contains the word UPI (the Transfers rule triggers on UPI/IMPS/NEFT/RTGS in the body) - any unrecognised-merchant UPI debit lands in Transfers. Transfers is a label; only isTransfer (same-day debit+credit) excludes from totals.

messages.note: Merchant is nil: the merchant lookahead needs whitespace before end-of-string, and 'At paytm' ends the body.

messages.note: SBI UPI format 'debited by 560.0' has no Rs/INR/rupee token, so the amount regex finds nothing: Unreadable (counted in the 'couldn't read' tally).

messages.note: Classified transactional by the pack (REFUND is in transactionalStrong); the parser then rejects it (INITIATED is an exclude word), so it is not a transaction. Desktop and phone now read the same classifier lists from the pack (F-044 7.4), so they agree.

messages.body: Rs.500 debited
Rs 200 paid to MERCHANT via Paytm
Your order has been delivered. Rs 799 paid via UPI
messages.note: A delivery notice from a DLT header that is not in nonBankSenders (AMZNIN vs AMAZON) that also mentions UPI/'paid'. The classifier keeps its spec order (transactional before service, F-048 11.2) so it is transactional, but the parser rejects delivery notices (DELIVERED / OUT FOR DELIVERY / SHIPPED / DISPATCHED are exclude words, F-048 11.5 'delivery/service all correctly excluded'). Previously parsed as a Rs 799 debit.

messages.body: hey sent you Rs 500 for dinner, check
messages.note: Parser alone accepts it (a 'sent' verb + Rs); it is the classifier (sender is a bare phone number => Personal) that keeps it out of the pipeline. The cross-language contract is the pipeline: classifier gate then parse.

messages.body: Recharge of Rs 299 successful. Validity 28 days
messages.note: Classified promotional by the pack (RECHARGE is in promoKeywords). Not a transaction either way (the sender AIRTEL is also a non-bank sender).

messages.body: Payment of Rs 12,400 received towards your HDFC Bank Credit Card XX9981. Thank you
messages.note: A card issuer acknowledging that the user paid their card bill. The purchases on the card were already counted one by one, so counting the bill payment again would double the spend; the account debit that funded it is its own message. The parser rejects it (rejectPatterns). Previously parsed as a Rs 12,400 debit.

messages.note: Balance-only alert: a debit verb, but the only figure is the balance. It must not be counted as the debit amount (spec D5/D6: no usable amount = unreadable). 'AVAILABLE BALANCE IN YOUR ACCOUNT IS ' puts the balance word 20+ chars before the figure, further than the old 14-char lookbehind.

messages.body: Dear customer, A/C XX4521 was debited on 12-Jun. Avl bal after txn: Rs. 14,200.50
messages.note: Same family: the balance is the only figure and follows a phrase longer than 14 chars.

messages.body: A/C XX1234 debited today. Rs 5,000.00 is your available balance
messages.note: The balance word FOLLOWS the figure ('Rs 5,000.00 is your available balance'); a lookbehind alone cannot see it.

messages.body: Low avl bal alert. Rs 700 debited from A/C XX1234 at SHOPX on 10-06
messages.note: Control: a balance word in an EARLIER sentence must not drop the real amount - the balance context stops at the sentence boundary.

messages.body: Avl bal Rs 9,000 Rs 200 debited from A/C XX1234
messages.note: Control: the balance context also stops at the previous amount, so the balance word that belongs to Rs 9,000 does not drop Rs 200.

messages.body: We have received your payment of Rs 1,200 towards your ICICI credit card XX4321. Thank you
messages.note: Another phrasing of the card-bill payment acknowledgement.

messages.body: Thank you for the payment of Rs 8,500 on your SBI Card XX2210
messages.note: Card-bill payment acknowledgement without the word 'received'.

messages.body: Rs 1,200 spent on HDFC Bank Credit Card XX4321 at AMAZON on 12-Jun-26.
messages.note: Control: a purchase on a credit card is still a debit.

messages.body: Your order is out for delivery. Rs 499 paid via UPI
messages.note: Delivery notice from a header outside nonBankSenders.

messages.body: Your parcel has been shipped. Rs 250 paid via UPI, delivery by Friday
messages.note: Shipping notice from a header outside nonBankSenders (review of PR #65: this fixture used MYNTRA, which IS in nonBankSenders, so it passed on the old code for the wrong reason and never exercised the SHIPPED exclude word).

messages.body: Your order has been dispatched. Rs 650 paid via UPI
messages.note: Same, DISPATCHED. Header outside nonBankSenders, so only the exclude word rejects it.

messages.body: Rs.799 debited from A/C XX1234 for AMAZON order via UPI
messages.note: Control: the bank's own debit alert for an order is a real debit (the delivery rejects only match delivery notices).

messages.body: Rs 40 paid for delivery fee to SWIGGY via UPI
messages.note: Control: the bare word DELIVERY (a fee) is not a delivery notice - only DELIVERED / OUT FOR DELIVERY / SHIPPED / DISPATCHED are.

messages.note: Control: CAFE became a whole-word trigger, so CAFETERIA is listed as its own substring trigger.

messages.body: Acct XX1234 debited Rs.1250.00 Avl Bal Rs.8420.10
messages.note: Compact alert where the balance LABEL follows the real amount with no punctuation between ('debited Rs.1250.00 Avl Bal Rs.8420.10'). 'Avl Bal' labels the NEXT figure, so 1250 is the transaction; the trailing-balance form must not drop it. (Regression found in review of the first v2 rule: it read the word after the 1250 as 'Rs 1250 is the balance' and the real debit became unreadable.)

messages.body: Sent Rs.500 Avl Bal Rs.2000
messages.note: Same family, 'Sent' verb.

messages.body: Acct XX1234 debited for Rs 500 Avl Bal: Rs 2,000
messages.note: Same family, colon after the balance label.

messages.body: Rs 500 balance transfer fee debited from A/C XX1234
messages.note: Control: 'balance' after the figure is part of a fee description, not the clause-closing 'is your available balance' form.

messages.body: A/C XX1234 debited today. Rs 5,000.00 is your available balance in your account
messages.note: Balance-only alert, trailing form closed by 'in your account': still unreadable.

messages.body: Rs 200 debited from A/C XX1234, Rs 9,000 avl bal
messages.note: Control: the balance figure with its label AFTER it is dropped; the debit stays.

messages.body: Dear Balaji, your A/C XX1234 has been debited by Rs 500
messages.note: A customer name that starts with BAL ('Balaji', 'Balu') is not a balance word: balance words must be WHOLE words. The 48-char context window made this drop real debits that the old 14-char lookbehind kept.

messages.body: Payment to ABC PRIVATE LIMITED of Rs 500 debited from A/C XX1234
messages.note: 'LIMITED' is not the balance word LIMIT.

messages.body: Thank you for the payment of Rs 800 at SHOPX using your Card XX1234
messages.note: A card PURCHASE confirmation that happens to say 'thank you for the payment ... Card'. The bill-payment reject patterns do not cross ' AT <merchant>'.

messages.body: Your payment of Rs 500 to SWIGGY was received by the merchant. Card XX1234
messages.note: A purchase receipt, not a card-bill acknowledgement: the payment goes TO a merchant, so the reject patterns do not fire.

messages.body: Rs.150 paid to CAFECOFFEEDAY via UPI
messages.note: Control: the UPI handle of Cafe Coffee Day used to match the CAFE substring trigger; it keeps its own substring trigger now that CAFE is whole-word.

messages.note: Control: OLAMONEY (same reason as OLACABS).

messages.note: Control: CREDCLUB, the CRED merchant's UPI name, keeps filing under Financial.
